at b9bacd5e97eded6b5bcb0ad37d0a30b8a4ecb291 (Apache-2.0; LICENSE retained).
Only the pure evaluator/types and its exact parity fixture are included.
The upstream evaluator's SOURCE_REVISION is d55a0f4d4edfabe49d8fd543aff473084cb741f2;
